title: Hotswap Installed SIM
description: Simulate physically swapping the installed SIM card. Sets the new iccid/imsi and drives the full remove->insert->app-ready sequence: card_state ABSENT/UNKNOWN, then sub_info_changed with the new identity, then card_state PRESENT/UNKNOWN, then PRESENT/READY. Emits 3 card_state + 1 sub_info_changed indication, synchronously.

slot.description: Which SIM slot to hotswap. Only slot 1 is supported.
